--- create_search_index_order_by_interleave_column.sql
-- an ORDER BY column named interleave before the INTERLEAVE IN clause
CREATE SEARCH INDEX AlbumsIndex
ON Albums(AlbumTitle_Tokens)
PARTITION BY SingerId
ORDER BY interleave DESC, INTERLEAVE IN Singers
--- AST
&ast.CreateSearchIndex{
  Create: 71,
  Name:   &ast.Path{
    Idents: []*ast.Ident{
      &ast.Ident{
        NamePos: 91,
        NameEnd: 102,
        Name:    "AlbumsIndex",
      },
    },
  },
  TableName: &ast.Path{
    Idents: []*ast.Ident{
      &ast.Ident{
        NamePos: 106,
        NameEnd: 112,
        Name:    "Albums",
      },
    },
  },
  TokenListPart: []*ast.Ident{
    &ast.Ident{
      NamePos: 113,
      NameEnd: 130,
      Name:    "AlbumTitle_Tokens",
    },
  },
  Rparen:           130,
  PartitionColumns: []*ast.Ident{
    &ast.Ident{
      NamePos: 145,
      NameEnd: 153,
      Name:    "SingerId",
    },
  },
  OrderBy: &ast.OrderBy{
    Order: 154,
    Items: []*ast.OrderByItem{
      &ast.OrderByItem{
        DirPos: 174,
        Expr:   &ast.Ident{
          NamePos: 163,
          NameEnd: 173,
          Name:    "interleave",
        },
        Dir: "DESC",
      },
    },
  },
  Interleave: &ast.InterleaveIn{
    Comma:     178,
    TableName: &ast.Ident{
      NamePos: 194,
      NameEnd: 201,
      Name:    "Singers",
    },
  },
}

--- SQL
CREATE SEARCH INDEX AlbumsIndex ON Albums(AlbumTitle_Tokens) PARTITION BY SingerId ORDER BY interleave DESC, INTERLEAVE IN Singers
